title: wwwf-1997-world
label: Stone Cold Steve Austin
how: Won an Iron Man tournament final over Mr. Perfect, 4 falls to 3
note: The fed's own first World Champion; no title change recorded in the held record's 1997 holdings.

title: wwwf-1997-world-tag-team
label: The Head Hunters
how: Won a six-team tournament final Death Match over Randy Savage and Sting, three straight pinfalls
note: The fed's own first World Tag Team Champions; no title change recorded in the held record's 1997 holdings.

title: wwwf-1997-us
label: Head Hunter #1
how: Won a 16-man over-the-top-rope battle royal, last eliminating Shawn Michaels
note: The fed's own first United States Champion; no title change recorded in the held record's 1997 holdings.
